assets.name: ground-garden
assets.prompt: Edit this map into a GROUND-ONLY background layer for a top-down RPG. Remove ALL raised objects: every tree, canopy, bush, dry branch, log, rock, ruin, building, wall, statue, campfire and debris. Remove the lakes and crater too, replacing them with grass and dirt. Keep the branching beige footpaths in approximately the same positions and the mossy olive-green grass colors. Inpaint empty ground where all objects were. The entire square must be flat ground only, uninterrupted to all four edges, NO border or walls. Subtle grass blades and tiny ground speckles only. No cast object shadows, no objects, no logos or text. High-resolution square map background.

assets.name: ground-ash
assets.prompt: Edit this map into a GROUND-ONLY layer for a top-down RPG. Ground must fill the entire square to every edge. NO building, no objects, no logo, no border, no text. High-resolution square map background.

assets.name: prop-tree

assets.name: aurorabroken-logo
assets.prompt: Logo for a dark fantasy action RPG. Exact title text: AuroraBroken (spelled A u r o r a B r o k e n, no spaces). Highly readable elegant custom serif lettering, pale aged gold with subtle weathered stone texture. Above the title a circular rising sun fractured into two slightly separated halves, amber light in the crack, restrained mystical rays. Horizontal lockup, emblem centered above lettering, premium understated old-world game branding. Only the emblem and the exact word AuroraBroken. No subtitle, no other text, no background scene, no mockup, no border. True transparent alpha background.
